slides.title: What Happened Friday
slides.body: The S&P 500 closed at 6,910.39 on Nov 20, down 3.7% on the day. The Nasdaq fell 5.3% and the Dow 1.9%. The S&P 500 and Dow are now more than 10% below their peaks, the usual definition of a correction.

slides.title: Weekly Losses, Nov 16 to 20
slides.subtitle: Change over the week (bar = size of drop)
slides.body: Chip stocks led the drop. The 10-year Treasury yield fell to 4.91% as investors sought safer assets.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: Nvidia fell 14% Friday and 71 of the 101 Nasdaq-100 stocks are in a bear market (down 20% or more). Many 401(k) and index funds hold these stocks. The Fed also signals more rate hikes ahead.

slides.title: Save This: What to Watch Next
items: Nov 26: US stock markets closed for Thanksgiving
Dec 8-9: Fed meeting, a rate hike is expected
